description.value: Qualicum Beach House is a family-run beachfront vacation property on Vancouver Island's premier walk-on waterfront, offering three self-contained suites (Brant, Heron, and Eagle) that can be rented individually or combined for up to 10 guests. The property sits along the Strait of Georgia and provides direct coastal access with kayaks and floaty toys available for guests. It is within walking distance of restaurants and trails, and is well-positioned as a base for exploring the Island.

address.value: 3267 West Island Highway, Qualicum Beach, BC V9K 2C7

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and detailed, confirming an active beachfront vacation suite rental property in Qualicum Beach with three named suites. Laundry is explicitly listed as an amenity in the Brant and Heron suite descriptions, and Wi-Fi is confirmed across all suites ('Smart TV and WiFi are included in the rental'; 'Now offering free wireless internet'). The website notes 'within walking distance to popular restaurants,' confirming nearby evening food. No bike-specific amenities (storage, tools, wash, e-bike charging) are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: Phone number has an 867 area code (Yukon/NWT/Nunavut), which is unusual for a Qualicum Beach, BC business. Both OSM and the website show the same number, so it is likely the owner's personal cell phone from another province, but may confuse guests expecting a BC number.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly bookable beachfront accommodation with a functioning website and confirmed contact details. Useful stop for touring cyclists on Vancouver Island.

Laundry.detail: Laundry explicitly listed for Brant Suite ('fully equipped kitchen, laundry') and Heron Suite ('newly fully equipped kitchen, laundry')

Nearby evening food.detail: Website states the property is 'within walking distance to popular restaurants.'

wow_evidence: family-run beachfront vacation property... direct coastal access with kayaks and floaty toys
